title: Unique Means Unique
prompt: Implement add_user(conn, email) inserting into users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE). A duplicate email must raise ValueError('duplicate email') — translate the sqlite3.IntegrityError (module 5 chaining!).

tests.name: first insert succeeds
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)')
assert add_user(conn, 'a@x.io') == 1

tests.name: duplicate translated
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)')
add_user(conn, 'a@x.io')
try:
    add_user(conn, 'a@x.io')
    failed = False
except ValueError as e:
    failed = 'duplicate email' in str(e)
assert failed
tests.hint: Catch sqlite3.IntegrityError, raise ValueError from it.
